from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class INA226_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    REG_WIDTH = 16

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.regs = {
            0x00: 0x4127,  # CONFIG
            0x01: 0x0000,  # SHUNT_VOLTAGE
            0x02: 0x0000,  # BUS_VOLTAGE
            0x03: 0x0000,  # POWER
            0x04: 0x0000,  # CURRENT
            0x05: 0x0000,  # CALIBRATION
            0x06: 0x0000,  # MASK_ENABLE
            0x07: 0x0000,  # ALERT_LIMIT
            0xFE: 0x5449,  # MANUFACTURER_ID
            0xFF: 0x2260,  # DIE_ID
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if addr not in self.regs:
            return 0xFFFF  # Unspecified address returns all 1s

        value = self.regs[addr]

        if nbytes == 1:
            return (value >> 8) & 0xFF  # Return high byte

        return value

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if addr not in self.regs or self.regs[addr] & (1 << 15):  # If RST bit is set, ignore writes
            return

        if addr == 0x00 and nbytes == 2:
            self.regs[addr] = 0x4127  # Self-clearing reset bit
            return

        if nbytes == 1:
            mask = 0xFF00
            data <<= 8
        else:
            mask = 0xFFFF

        current_value = self.regs[addr]
        new_value = (current_value & ~mask) | (data & mask)
        self.regs[addr] = new_value
